definitions.explanation: The head of a university or college, responsible for its overall administration and academic leadership.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{学長|がくちょう}が{挨拶|あいさつ}をした。
examples.english: The university president gave an opening address.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{学長|がくちょう}が{選|えら}ばれた。
{学長|がくちょう}は{入学式|にゅうがくしき}で{新入生|しんにゅうせい}を{歓迎|かんげい}した。
examples.english: The president welcomed the new students at the entrance ceremony.

notes:
Composed of {学|がく} (learning, school) + {長|ちょう} (head, chief). Specifically the head of a university, as distinct from the head of a lower school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学長|がくちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to take office as university president
- {学長|がくちょう}{選挙|せんきょ}: election for university president

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {校長|こうちょう}: principal — head of an elementary, junior high, or high school
- {総長|そうちょう}: president — used by some large universities in place of {学長|がくちょう}
- {学部長|がくぶちょう}: dean — head of a single faculty, below the {学長|がくちょう}
